blocks.text: Zscaler Zero Trust Branch has two components:

blocks.item: Zero Trust Branch appliances: Provide forwarding and network enforcement points deployed in the customer environments. Depending on the throughput and scale requirements, there are different physical and virtual options available.
Zscaler Admin Console: A centralized Software as a Service (SaaS) management portal used to manage Zero Trust Branch appliances.
